title: Unique Paths
description: There is a robot on an `m x n` grid. The robot is initially located at top-left corner `(0, 0)` and can only move either down or right at any point in time. Return the number of possible unique paths to the bottom-right corner `(m - 1, n - 1)`.
hints: Total moves required: (m - 1) down moves and (n - 1) right moves.
Any path is a sequence of (m - 1 + n - 1) total moves.
The answer is combination: `C(m + n - 2, m - 1)`.

reference_solution:
import sys, math
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    m, n = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    print(math.comb(m + n - 2, m - 1))
